package.description: Flexible LDAP proxy for inspecting and transforming LDAP traffic

en-US.description: Flexible LDAP proxy for inspecting and transforming LDAP traffic
en-US.name: ldapx
en-US.releaseNotes:
New Features
- Added a new filter middleware K (SortKeyFold) that disguises search values by swapping characters for look-alike Unicode variants the server still matches the same way (accented, full-width, circled letters, ligatures, and many more). K can be narrowed to chosen look-alike categories (accented, width, enclosed, script, symbols, ligatures) via FiltSortKeyFoldClasses / BDNSortKeyFoldClasses - e.g. accented alone reads like ordinary foreign-language text.
- The Unicode filter middlewares (U, W, K) now also disguise DN values inside filters (e.g. member=, distinguishedName=).
- Added three new BaseDN middlewares (N, A, K) that apply the same Unicode disguises to the BaseDN of any operation.
- Added interception of the LDAP Compare operation (enable with -C / --compare), so the configured middlewares now transform Compare requests as well as searches and writes.

Improvements
- The AltSpace middlewares (W, A) gained an IncludeVisible option (FiltAltSpaceIncludeVisible / BDNAltSpaceIncludeVisible): when enabled, spaces can also be replaced by space-folding code points that render as a visible glyph, in addition to the "invisible" ones used by default.
- The IgnorableUnicode middlewares (U, N) mode is now a comma-separated list of categories instead of a single value. Alongside invisible and marks, four visible-stripper categories were added - modlet, modsym, symbols, punct (all ignored by the server, but they render) - and all now means every category. The default stays invisible + combining marks, so nothing visible appears unless a visible category is named.
- Unknown option names are now rejected (both via -o at startup and set option in the shell) instead of being silently accepted and ignored, so a mistyped option is reported immediately.

Changelog
- b1ed1a6: Adding 'aurs' block to goreleaser. (@Macmod)
- e877bdd: Adding support to LDAP Compare. (@Macmod)
- ebbd3d5: Bumping version. (@Macmod)
- 81a8077: Improvements to Unicode obfuscation middlewares (introducing K for filter/baseDN, new possibilities for IgnorableUnicode/AltSpace, introducing N/A as U/W alternatives for baseDN obfuscation, making U/W/K also work with DN values in filters and other fixes). (@Macmod)
- 80801c5: Updating release workflow. (@Macmod)
